subject: planner: add enumeration of index join with indexJoinProp pushed down to inner plan. (#60449)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. It adds new (currently-unused) helper functions for enumerating IndexJoin/IndexHashJoin with `IndexJoinRuntimeProp` pushed down, and adjusts physical task enumeration to prefer plans matching INL* join hints via `suitLogicalJoinHint`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics for the active code paths touched by this change; later upstream history further refactors hint selection/enforcement in this area.
